rho_reference.kind_note: tuned negation-map walk (RhoWalk::negation); prime-field curves, no Frobenius; no curve has j = 0 or 1728 (validator-checked), so no automorphism fold exists; the plain tuned walk is also measured and the best of the two is reported per price
rho_reference.unit: group operations of the arm's own group (1 GAE each) + w x native operations (IC: mul mod p, mul mod r and the recorded arms' counters; rho: canonicalisations, partition hashes, DP lookups, DP inserts, word operations). IC arms on a Jacobian count a Cantor step as 1 GAE although it costs 4.3 to 22.5 elliptic additions in best-of-N time (4.3 to 9.8 for the word-implementation and tower Jacobians, 20 to 22.5 for the recorded implementations), so every IC/rho ratio is understated; the IC-above order is conservative.
